prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: a stack of paper coins; a rubber stamp.
Opens on the linked buildings, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip is covered as the linked buildings collapse into a tall coin stack; a rubber stamp presses down on it.
Ends holding on the coin stack.
This composition is oversized: one subject fills most of the frame.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "$1.5B". This is the hero beat: the number may print larger, up to half the frame width.

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "$1.5B". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a refined 2D motion design style, photographed as a flat lay under soft, natural room light. <Picture 1> establishes the initial state: a pale cyan, single-color paper ground. In the upper third, a cream-colored paper chip with rough torn edges bears the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "4 ACQUISITIONS". Below it, four black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of modern buildings, each with rough white torn-paper edges, are arranged in a diagram connected by pale yellow paper ribbons and small black pins. Each element casts a small, soft shadow from a consistent light source in the upper left. Immediately, the action begins: the initial "4 ACQUISITIONS" chip is swiftly covered by a new, larger cream paper chip that slides in from the left, featuring the bold black text "$1.5B", where the number occupies nearly half the frame width. Simultaneously, the four building cutouts and their connecting ribbons collapse and merge inward with fast motion and a slight overshoot, transforming into a single, oversized stack of black-and-white halftone paper coins. The coin cutouts are plain and unmarked, with rough white torn edges and a matte texture. As the coin stack stabilizes in the center of the lower two-thirds of the frame, a black rubber stamp cutout rapidly presses down onto the top of the stack and lifts away. The camera remains a Static Shot throughout the 5-second duration. The final frame holds on the stable composition of the "$1.5B" headline and the oversized coin stack against the pale cyan background.

overall_soundscape: The audio consists of crisp, tactile foley sounds. A sharp, rhythmic paper-slap occurs as the headline chip covers the previous one, followed by a collective, soft rustling sound as the buildings collapse into the coin stack. The sequence concludes with a single, resonant thud of a rubber stamp hitting paper.
